36935.name: PITAKA Iphone 18 Pro Cairn Case (California Dream-01)

bullets.title: Bow-Arc Corner Buffer 2.0
bullets.text: The four corners feature an arched design that naturally creates space around the phone, acting like built-in air cushions. On impact, they deform to absorb shock, ensuring even accidental drops land softly.

bullets.title: Seamless Capacitive Button
bullets.text: Featuring high-strength glass to protect camera buttons well and preserve touch sensitivity. Ensures your operations remain smooth.

bullets.title: Premium Weave
bullets.text: Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, our case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It's not just light and strong — it's a pleasure to hold, every single time.

bullets.title: CALIFORNIA DREAM
bullets.text: It was the 1970s, California. The Pacific breeze mingled with the scorching heat of transistors. Disco grooves resonated with the pulse of binary code. In garages, scattered schematics were mapping out drafts that would change the world. The sunset was like a long exposure, And the future was already awakening in the golden afterglow.

bullets.title: 1001 Nights
bullets.text: Once, we looked to the moon to tell time, and to the stars to find our way. As the moon rises, drifts, and fades, the senses buried beneath the noise of everyday life slowly begin to surface. From dusk to deep night, the world grows quieter, Then we find our way back to ourselves.
